params.prompt: A mellow acoustic song with a clear solo vocal and gentle guitar.
params.lyrics:
[verse]
Morning light upon the sea
A quiet song comes back to me
We walk along the shore today
And watch the shadows drift away
[chorus]
Sing the song and let it shine
Your melody will stay with mine

params.prompt: A warm acoustic folk song with a solo singer, guitar, piano, bass and a gentle drum groove.
params.verse:
Morning light upon the sea
A quiet song comes back to me
We walk along the shore today
And watch the shadows drift away
The silver moon will guide us home
We never have to walk alone
The roads will turn and seasons change
Our melody will stay the same
params.chorus:
Sing the song and let it shine
Your melody will stay with mine
Across the hills and through the rain
We find our way back home again
params.bridge:
When the lights are fading low
There is still a way to go
Hold the note and take my hand
We will reach the morning land
params.vocals: Clear solo singing with natural dynamics.
params.arrangement: Intro, verse, chorus, verse, chorus, instrumental bridge, final chorus, gentle outro.
